ui.winner: 🏆 {name} is the Victor of the Games!
ui.winnerNone: ☠ The arena claims everyone. No victor.
ui.devTributeHint: Changes apply to the live game only; they never leak into setup.
ui.packsEmpty: No packs saved yet. Save your current tributes (including relationships) as a reusable pack.
ui.relHint: Each cell is how the row tribute feels about the column tribute. Drag the sliders in the setup phase. The Games will change these on their own.
ui.logEmpty: No events yet. Add tributes and start the Games.
ui.confirmReset: Reset the Games? Tributes are kept, progress is wiped.
ui.confirmExample: Replace current tributes with the 8 example tributes?
ui.needTwo: Add at least two tributes first.
ui.goalHint: Short-term goal: what this tribute is trying to do today, based on the world around them.
ui.winAllianceHint: Tributes in the same alliance win together if they are the last faction standing. Solo tributes always compete alone.
ui.winmodeHint.survivors: Everyone alive when the end day arrives wins.
ui.winmodeHint.boss_slayer: Whoever helped slay the Bosses and is alive wins — the game ends only when ALL bosses are dead. If the last boss flees, everyone loses.
ui.winmodeHint.hg_plus: The last alliance (or solo tribute) standing wins — allied tributes win together.
ui.abCond: Trigger condition (optional; mini-language: self.health < 30, self female, hasItem self knife)
ui.persWeights: Action weights (how much this personality prefers each action)
ui.globalsHint: Global events last a set number of days/nights, and can replace, influence, or add to a phase. Edit them in config/globalEvents.json.
ui.bossExplosion: Death blast damage (to those who fought it)
ui.bossHint: No behaviors = stationary. Tributes hunt it each phase — defeat it or wait out the duration. Health is multiplied by squad size.
ui.outcomeHint: Choose the text after effects are applied. First condition that matches wins (no condition = fallback; otherwise the main template is used). Conditions: other.dead, self.dead, other.health < 30, self.health > 50, other female, other warrior, other rel self >= 20, hasItem self medkit, hasCat self medical, other is target.
ui.weaponTplsHint: Text used when the acting tribute fights with a weapon of this type; {weapon} is the item name, {self}/{other}/{others}/{group} as usual. Leave a field empty to fall back to the general template.
ui.scriptHint: JavaScript or Mini-language. Mini: one statement per line — log "...", grant self medkit, reward killer medkit,grenade, set target to random, trigger fight, spawn the_beast, fight other self, if victim is target … end. References: self, other, others (indexable: others[0]), killer, victim, target, random, randomOther, or memory vars. Placeholders in log: {self},{other},{others[0]},{killer},{victim},{target},{boss}. JS helpers: state, self, other, others (a real array — others[0].name works), memory, boss(), triggerEvent(cat, tributeId?), triggerGlobal(id), fight(a,b), tr(key, vars?), log(), grant(), grantLoot(), add/set/get(), setRel(a,b,value), addRel(a,b,delta), pickTribute({cond}), matches(), any(), byId(), isAlive(), rand(), choose(). Global hooks: onStart/onDay/onNight/onDeath/onDamage/onSlay/onEnd (onDeath: death.tribute, death.killer; onDamage: damage.target/amount/attacker/cause; onSlay fires when the Boss dies before winners — use g.boss.participants).
ui.subTitle: Sub-event
ui.subsEmpty: No sub-events. Click “+ add sub-event” to create alternative outcomes.
ui.targetsHint: 1 = alone · 2 = pair · 3+ = group · or a range like 2-4
ui.langEditHint: Switch the language to translate the labels used across the UI and in event/engine messages. In Keys mode, edit key-by-key; JSON mode edits the raw locale file.
ui.empty: None yet. Click “+ Add” to create one.
ui.tplPlaceholder: Use {self}, {other}, {others}, {group}. Example: {self} finds a knife and keeps it.

names.bossDefense: Defense (reduces damage taken; grows with squad size)
names.veteranHint: Earned by surviving fights and making kills. Veterans deal more damage and shrug off more.

engine.theftFight: Caught red-handed, {self} and {other} clash in a vicious fight.
engine.theftConfront: {other} catches {self} stealing and confronts them with threats and curses.
engine.theftCharm: {other} catches {self} stealing, but {self} talks their way out with a silver tongue.
engine.bossDrain: The {boss} ransacks the arena, devouring food and supplies.
engine.bossSquad: {squad} band together and assault the {boss} as a squad!
engine.bossSlain: The {boss} has been slain! The arena breathes easier.
engine.bossBlast: The {boss} explodes on death! {victims} are caught in the blast!
engine.replenish: A Gamemakers' supply drop replenishes the arena's resources. Everyone grabs what they can.
engine.allianceForge: {a} and {b} swear a pact and forge an alliance — {alliance}!
engine.allianceBreak: {name} turns on their allies and leaves the alliance!
engine.allianceDisband: {name} walks alone now — the {alliance} alliance has fallen apart.
engine.winnerGroup: 🏆 The Games are over. {names} survive to the end — they all win!
engine.win: 🏆 The Games are over. {name} is the last one standing — Victor!
engine.winGroup: 🏆 The Games are over. {names} survive to the end — they all win!
engine.winNone: The Games end with no victor. The arena claims everyone.
engine.startIntro: The countdown ends. A cannon sounds and the tributes surge toward the Cornucopia.
engine.gift: A sponsor parachute descends from the sky. {name} receives {item}.
engine.scout_confront: {other} catches {self} hiding and confronts them with threats and curses.
engine.scout_fight: {other} catches {self} hiding and they clash in a vicious fight due to suspiciousness!
engine.scout_charm: {other} catches {self} hiding, but {self} talks their way out with a silver tongue.
engine.scout_stealth: {other} catches {self} hiding, but {self} manages to sneak away.
